source_assumptions: Members main loot, no wealth, pre-Legends. Source-linked regular variants; no superior/boss/quest forms or task/Slayer gates.
Stalker bleed is deferred: Wiki itself notes uncertainty about its damage. Antler guard tertiary independent mature1/800 and elder1/650. Broken antler remains main-table, not guaranteed.
Dark beast double herb outcome gives two of the same selected herb; independent herb identity rolls deferred. Magic-melee-only prototype reuses existing spell logic; exact source switching deferred.
Dust devil uses ordinary melee prototype; ranged-based defence, facemask protection and temporary stat drains deferred. Existing character XP never drained.
Ent has no combat loot: post-kill trunk chopping, Woodcutting-dependent log distribution and nests require a separate harvesting checkpoint.
Gargoyle damage stops at1HP until reusable rock hammer is used within5 yards at8 source HP or lower. Auto-smash perk, thrownhammer, granite hammer and golembane effects deferred.
Dark beast and Gargoyle uniques are conditional prerolls; main probabilities preserved after preroll. Wilderness/task/quest/clue tertiary excluded. Source missing mass remains Nothing.
